entries.00761123329ba3f2: It provides plant insulation materials based on xonotlite-type calcium silicate material, and industrial heat-insulating materials used in industrial furnaces and heating equipment. entries.f8fc7d6ab88a4f3d: It provides building materials based on xonotlite-type calcium silicate material. Its product lineup includes fireproof coating materials that protect structural members such as steel beams and columns and seismic isolation devices from flames and heat in a fire; interior building materials, which are noncombustible interior finishes that can be design-processed; and multifunctional materials such as craft boards, CFRP molding materials and inorganic powders. The fireproof coating materials are products that have obtained certification under the Building Standards Act.
entries.f941001d9cbb6000: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,393 million, up 17.8% from the previous year. Plant-related revenue was ¥9,278 million and construction-related revenue was ¥5,114 million. In construction-related business, orders for fireproof coating work for logistics facilities, offices and others increased, while in plant-related business, maintenance and construction work in the steel, chemical and petroleum sectors, among others, was firm.
